run_GraphPredictionTask_run_gnn: run the GraphPredictionTask GNN training loop with distributed data parallel on graph prediction data
create_collate_fn: create a collate function that pads adjacency matrices and weights for graph data batches
evaluate_GraphPredictionTask_evaluate: evaluate the graph prediction model on a data loader and return accuracy and loss metrics
review_GraphPredictionTask_forward: review the GraphPredictionTask forward method that computes scores and loss for regression or classification
load_GraphPredictionTask_load_data: load synthetic or real graph dataset using GraphDataset or SyntheticDataset with the collate function
